answer: When an AI agent joins the network it must lock a small stake into a cryptographic vault whose access key is derived from a unique hardware fingerprint and a time‑locked proof‑of‑work puzzle, producing a crystal‑clear identifier that cannot be duplicated. All agents that later share the same vault, payment source or exhibit identical timing patterns are automatically kin‑linked into a marble‑grade reputation cluster, and any new identity that tries to claim membership must also present a fresh, unspent lotus‑seed token that costs the network a fixed computational and monetary fee.
